# odigos-central_namespace (Resource)

Enables or disables Odigos instrumentation for a Kubernetes namespace on one data stream. Set `selected` to false to disable without destroying the resource. Destroying the resource removes it from `current_stream_name` only; other streams in `data_stream_names` (for example membership added outside this resource) are left unchanged. Changing `cluster_name` or `name` forces replacement. Changing `current_stream_name` moves the namespace between streams. Odigos allows one selection per namespace: a second resource for the same namespace on another stream is rejected. Change `current_stream_name` on the existing resource to move it. Creating or destroying several resources for the same namespace runs one at a time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odigos-central_namespace" "example" {
  cluster_name        = "my-cluster"
  name                = "my-namespace"
  current_stream_name = "default"
  selected            = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster (compute platform).
- `current_stream_name` (String) The name of the data stream to use when persisting namespace selection.
- `name` (String) The name of the namespace.

### Optional

- `selected` (Boolean) Whether the namespace is selected for instrumentation. Set to false to disable. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `data_stream_names` (List of String) The names of the data streams.
- `sources` (Attributes List) Sources in this namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `data_stream_names` (List of String) The names of the data streams for this source.
- `kind` (String) The kind of the source (e.g. Deployment).
- `name` (String) The name of the source.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the source.
- `number_of_instances` (Number) The number of instances (matches numberOfInstances).
- `selected` (Boolean) Whether the source is selected.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import odigos-central_namespace.example my-cluster/my-namespace/default
```
